# AniStream v2.0.0

AniStream 2.0 redesigns the whole app and adds movies and shows, an airing schedule, Up Next and
playlists, and offline library edits. Your local progress, AniList session, and backups carry over
from 0.1.x.

- 🎉 More: New section for movies and shows
  - Browse trending movies and shows with TMDB data and search
  - Full-width hero with title logos, plus All / Movies / Shows / My Watch List views
  - Title pages with creators, certification, and season episode grids with stills and
    progress
  - Embedded playback that tries each configured player in turn and uses the first one that
    starts. "Switch player" changes it by hand
  - Local resume and Continue Watching for movies and episodes
  - Add to Watch List or mark Completed, and rate completed titles from 1 to 10
- 🎉 Simkl: Optional sync for movies and shows
  - Connect Simkl from **Settings → Account** or the sign-in screen. AniList stays in charge of
    anime and manga
  - Imports your Simkl movies, shows, and ratings into More and its For You rows
  - Watch-list, Completed, and rating changes made in AniStream are sent back to Simkl
  - Trending on Simkl this week rows, and a Simkl profile with watch-time stats
  - Disconnect any time; the sign-in is stored encrypted on this device
- 🎉 For You: New recommendation engine that runs entirely on your device
  - Ranks titles by AniList recommendations from what you liked, how closely their tags, genres,
    and creators match your taste (rarer themes count more), and their popularity and rating
  - "Because you watched…" and "Because you like…" rows rotate through your whole history, and no
    single title can fill them
  - One slot is saved for a well-rated pick outside your usual taste
  - Unstarted sequels point you to the first season instead
  - Starts after three watched or read titles, and the hero personalizes from what you watch
  - **Not interested** hides a title and teaches the rows
- 🎉 Learn from my activity: For You can now learn from how you watch on this device (what you
  start, finish, or abandon, and how long it takes to find something to play), not only from your
  lists and ratings
  - It stays on this device. Turn it off in **Settings → Customize app**, which also deletes what
    was measured
- 🎉 Up Next & Playlists: Queue what you want to watch next
  - Queue anime, movies, shows, or single episodes from title pages and episode tiles
  - Save the queue as a playlist and play it later
  - A 5-second countdown starts the next episode or queued title, and you can cancel it
  - Backups include your queue and playlists
- 🎉 Airing schedule: Keep up with what's airing
  - Calendar button in the navbar with Week, Month, and All airing views
  - "Ready for you" lists new episodes and chapters you haven't watched or read yet
  - Episodes and titles that haven't aired show when they arrive instead of a play button
  - Anime title pages list upcoming episodes, the weekly slot, and the finale
- 🎉 Offline mode: Keep using your library without a connection
  - Your saved AniList session and library open offline
  - Library edits and progress are saved on this device and sync automatically once AniList is
    reachable again
  - Hero and Continue artwork is cached on this device so it still shows while offline
- 🎉 Windows updates: Future releases download in the background and install with one click on
  **Restart to update**, checked against the release's SHA-512 hash
- 🎉 Settings: New Settings page with Account, Customize app, Playback, Reading, Backup, and Updates
  - Turn off Up Next, the schedule button, For You rails, rotating heroes, or learning from your
    activity
  - Reduce motion on every platform, and choose which section opens first
  - Pick Sub or Dub as the default audio and turn autoplay on or off
- 💄 Title pages: Full pages replace the old overlays
  - AniList banner, cover, facts card, sticky section tabs, episodes or chapters, and the best six
    More like this picks
  - Scores from each source shown with its logo, and the original creator in the facts card
  - Anime episode tiles show episode stills when they are available
  - Manga pages use each title's own accent colour, plus a chapter list grouped by volume with
    read and up-next markers
- 💄 Home, Anime & Manga: Rotating hero of trending titles, wide Continue Watching cards, book-style
  Continue Reading cards, and title actions when you hover over a poster
- 💄 Profile: Banner header with stats and sync status
  - Anime and Manga library tabs with status chips, grid and list views, and per-library filters
  - Redesigned entry editor
- 💄 Manga reader: Redesigned controls
  - Chapter drawer grouped by volume with jump search, page counter, and a reader settings popover
  - Shortcuts: C chapters, S settings, W fit, F fullscreen
- 💄 Player: Watching fills the window, and the controls hide until you need them. The anime player
  has a one-click Sub/Dub switch
- 💄 Sign in: New welcome screen with Continue with AniList and Browse as guest
- 💄 Loading: A calmer launch screen, shaped placeholders while title pages load, and failure
  messages that name the service that is down
- ⚡️ Search: One search per section (Ctrl+K) with results as you type
  - Anime and Manga filters for genre, format, status, season, year, country, tag, score, and sort
- ⚡️ Continue: Remove a title with the X on its card. Undo is available for a few seconds, and the
  title comes back when you watch or read it again
- ⚡️ Manga: An optional chapter source adds English chapters that MangaDex doesn't have. They open in
  the in-app reader
- ⚡️ Manga: Titles that MangaDex search misses are now found by their exact AniList link
- ⚡️ MyAnimeList: Fills in a missing summary, English title, or genres and credits the source
- ⚡️ No ads: Embedded players can only load the scripts they need to play, so player ads and
  trackers never run. Analytics beacons from the anime player are blocked too
- ⚡️ More works out of the box: Official installers no longer need a TMDB key to be set up
- ⚡️ Report a bug: New account menu item that opens the GitHub issues page
- ⚡️ Settings: Turn off the Latest Updates grids
- ⚡️ Manga: Exact MangaDex matches are remembered on this device, so title pages open faster
- 🦺 Manga: Fixed "Chapters didn't load" when a title was closed and quickly reopened
- 🦺 Manga: Fixed the chapter list not scrolling
- 🦺 Manga: Chapters with alternative names (such as "Official Scans 12") are no longer dropped
- 🦺 Player: Fixed the top of the Back and player buttons not responding to clicks
- 🦺 Profile: Large libraries no longer fail to save for offline use
- 🦺 Continue: Unfinished titles now appear before finished ones
- 🦺 Continue: Finished titles no longer come back because of an old checkpoint
- 🦺 Profile: A new AniList picture, banner, or name now shows after the next launch
- 🦺 Settings: Preferences in installed builds are kept between launches
- 🏗️ Backups: 0.1.x backups still restore. Backups from 2.0 add Up Next and playlists, which older
  versions ignore
- 🏗️ The update notification bell was replaced by the airing schedule
- 🏗️ Characters, Staff, and Related sections were removed from anime and manga title pages
- 🏗️ Releases include a `SHA256SUMS.txt` file to verify downloads
- 🏗️ New issue forms, pull request template, contributing guide, and security policy
- ⬆️ Updated Electron to 44.7.0

## Downloads

- `AniStream-2.0.0-arm64.dmg`: Apple Silicon macOS 12+
- `AniStream.Setup.2.0.0.exe`: Windows x64

Install over your existing copy. Your local data and AniList session are kept. To be safe, export
a backup first from **Settings → Backup**.

Both packages are unsigned. Signing and notarization are not configured yet.

- **macOS:** the first launch is blocked. Open AniStream once, then go to **System Settings →
  Privacy & Security** and select **Open Anyway** next to the AniStream message. On macOS 14 and
  earlier, Control-click → Open also works.
- **Windows:** SmartScreen may warn about an unrecognized app. Select **More info → Run anyway**.

Each download can be checked against the `SHA256SUMS.txt` file attached to this release.

Installed builds check GitHub for new releases at startup and from **Settings → Updates**.

From this version on, Windows updates install in the app: AniStream downloads a new release in the
background, checks it against the release's SHA-512 hash, and shows **Restart to update** when it
is ready. Nothing installs until you choose it. Background downloads and install-on-quit can be
changed in **Settings → Updates**. This release itself still has to be installed by hand. macOS
keeps linking to the release page.
